provenance.method: Static 16-bit x86 and Microsoft QuickBASIC 3 runtime data-flow reconstruction; no DOS execution

assignment_order: deep resource set and type < 6 => type

player_weapon_attack.attack_codes: S sword, M mace, K knife, F fist; B breathe fire uses the adjacent direct-damage path
player_weapon_attack.d20: roll=INT(RND*20)+1; attack_score += INT(combat_attack_factor*.7)+roll+player_level; repeat the complete accumulation while roll=20
player_weapon_attack.magic_bonus: sword adds magic_sword_bonus; mace adds magic_mace_bonus
player_weapon_attack.integer_conversion: INT the accumulated damage once before weapon modifiers
player_weapon_attack.one_shot_bonus_bug: DS:B6CE is added and reset only when pre-modifier damage is at least 1; a miss preserves it
player_weapon_attack.next_actor: INT(RND*50)+monster_turn_speed_bonus+1 < player_agility returns control to the player; otherwise the monster attacks
player_weapon_attack.cosmetic_rng: a zero-damage ordinary weapon attack consumes RND once for original message 1..5; a positive attack, including BREATHE FIRE, consumes RND once for message 6..10; both occur before defeat/next-actor tests

monster_attack_score.initialization: attack_score=0; damage=0 unless behavior class 3 retains an attack score after prior positive damage
monster_attack_score.reroll_condition: repeat the shared-roll increment and level accumulation only while shared_roll equals exactly 20
monster_attack_score.after_roll: attack_score += shared_roll-2; subtract another 2 when monster_level=1
monster_attack_score.note: DS:52FC is also the numeric menu/player-roll variable. Its previous value is intentionally not reset by the original monster routine.

monster_damage.level_term_bug: only when level_term<-10: set it to -10 and then ABS it, producing +10

hit_effects.deep_type_18: replace damage with INT(current_health*.25) and print SQUASH!!
hit_effects.behavior_class_5: experience*=0.7; player_level-=1; health_max=health_max-INT(RND*10)-health_growth_factor+1; consume another RND and display F2.COM combat message 11..15 before LEVEL DRAINED!; SAVE immediately after this block and before deep-set Strength drain

repeat_attack.guard: only one repeat is permitted; the guard resets when control returns to the player

death_test: player_level<0 OR health_current<0 (zero is not treated as dead here)
cannot_strike: when the counter is >1, decrement it and skip the strike; the repeat-attack check still runs
